description: mnemonic 1-3-gram TF-IDF + LinearSVC (rules_pipeline calibration baseline), family-holdout K-fold and LOFO on the all cohort

config.source: rules_pipeline/train_eval.py section (c), calibration baseline (pre-registered; not the tuned pick)

features.vectoriser: TfidfVectorizer(analyzer=word, token_pattern=\S+, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=5, sublinear_tf=True, max_features=300000)
features.fit_on: training rows of each fold / each LOFO train set only

classifier.name: LinearSVC
classifier.C_selection: GridSearchCV(cv=StratifiedKFold(2, shuffle=True, random_state=42), scoring=f1_macro) inside the training rows
